visa-preparation.entry_summary: Australians pay the Suriname Entry Fee online before travel (a short stay of up to 90 days), through the portal VFS runs as the authorised partner of Suriname's Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Business, transit and other purposes use an eVisa on the same portal.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Entry Fee paid online (single or multiple entry), up to 90 days.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Pay the Entry Fee on suriname.vfsevisa.com by card (US dollars or euros) and keep the email confirmation with its reference number.
visa-preparation.useful_stay: Up to 90 days on the Entry Fee.

steps.step: Pay the Entry Fee online and keep the confirmation email and reference number.
For business, study, work or other purposes, apply for the matching eVisa instead.
Transit passengers who don't leave the airport need no visa and pay no Entry Fee.

fees.item: Entry Fee, short stay up to 90 days (or EUR 50)

open_questions: No Smartraveller page covers Suriname, and the rules were read on the VFS-run portal rather than a Suriname government page; confirm with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or a Suriname mission.
